description: WASHINGTON—President Joe Biden recently canceled another $7.7 billion in student loans for 160,000 borrowers, bringing the total forgiven to $167 billion. Representative Aaron Bean (R-FL) denounced the erasure of debt in a recent interview with The Floridian, calling it "unfair" and an attempt "to win over young people."
paid_for_by: Paid for by Aaron Bean for Congress Media Inquiries: Sarah Bascom
title: Bean Denounces Biden's 'Unfair' Student Loan Forgiveness - Aaron Bean
